race.comment: DEFIANCE (2) has returned in excellent order, winning a Maiden at this track by just over four lengths before putting away Bound To Fire in a Nowra CL1 by just over three lengths as a prohibitive odds-on favourite. He faces a harder assignment, but he's a progressive type who can keep the winning streak alive. KENDALIA (9) is the clear danger after consecutive seconds at this venue, most recently beaten just over half a length by Tulipwood, and his consistency keeps him right in the contest. WILLINGHAM (10) has been placed at Goulburn at his past two, had interference last start and drops from 61kg to 57kg, so he has the profile to run into the minor money again. FAMOSO (3) draws the inside today and is not out of this on his best form.
